page.layout: One printed page, left page of the opening. One column of running text, with marginal notes in the left margin. Right of the text, the neighbouring page's edge is visible and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: „ Loricas non habebant, sed in veste succincti pugnabant.] Ego sic verto & exaudio, quod in Græco est ἐν περιζώμα-σι. At Lascaris fecit in subligaculis pugnasse. Neque negoSpreta vulgata versio. id quoque περιζώματα Græcis esse: sed quis credet nudos eos & campestri solo tectos pugnasse? Indecorum & inutile fuerit, tum etiam sine exemplis. Mea mens est, ve-Equites ve-ste cincti.ste saltem fuisse tectos, & quo magis expediti essent, super eam cinctos. Juvat Festus: Endo procinctu,in procinctu. nam apud antiquos togis incincti pugnasse dicuntur. Item Plutarchus de testamentis in procinctu: μέλλοντα[?] εἰς Ῥωμαίους[?] ἀναλαμβάνειν καὶ περιζώννυσθαι τὴν τήβεννον: Jam scuta capturis & togam accincturis[?]. Proprie autem adLib. vi. equites,quod Dionysius in Transfuectione[?] scribit: eos in Fortasse trabeati.togis quas Trabeas dicunt transfuectos[?], tanquam e pugnâ venirent. E quo colligas pugnasse eo habitu, & super trabeas fuisse cinctos. quod nec Virgilius abnuat:
Aliquid etiam huc Scholiastes vetus Horatij conferat, in illud ——cinctutis non exaudita Cethegis. Cinctutis, inquit, antiquè militaribus viris, & ad mili-tiam paratis.

„ Ad descensum ascensumque facilem in equos. ]Quod utrumque merito spectabant, cùm auxilio nullo aut fulcro uterentur ad allevandum. Lego interdum hastâVeteres quomodo in equum. innixos fuisse. ut in Livio, de Cornelio Cosso: Quem Lib. iiii.cùm equo ictum deiecisset, confestim & ipse hastâ innixus se in pedes excipit. Videntur & equos quidam insuevisse ad flectenda crura, & sese demittendum. ut Silius de equo mirae fidei & ingenij:

p.i: Inde inclinatus collum, submissus & armos, De more inflexis prabebat scandere terga cruribus[?].

page.notes: Doubtful readings: the Greek in the Plutarch line (μέλλοντα, Ῥωμαίους) is hard to make out. "capturis" and "accincturis" may be other forms. "Transfuectione" and "transfuectos" are uncertain in the printed ligature. "cruribus" has an unclear first letter. The opening line starts with a quotation mark and an indent, so I treated it as a new paragraph. The "Nempe" at lower right is taken as a catchword. Left margin notes were grouped by the lines they stand beside: "Veteres / quomodo / in equum." is one note. Ordinary printed spelling (Liuio, Cosso, vterentur, alleuandum, insueuisse) was normalised to u/v and i/j as instructed.
